big_case.notes: Pro se paid petition from a Wisconsin civil tort and insurance dispute over a home; the appeal below was dismissed as untimely under state law. The QP asks the Court to extend the criminal-sentencing appeal-advisement line to civil dismissals under the Fourteenth Amendment, a theory no lower court has adopted and no split frames. Respondents waived, no amicus, no CVSG, denied without comment at the long conference with no noted dissent. Stakes are personal to the petitioner; the case would have settled nothing beyond itself. Read formed from the QP, snapshot and petition.
